data.name: Lallan
data.gender_notes: Lallan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Lallan is the God of mirth and joy, often depicted as the Lord Shiva in his playful form. This name represents happiness, delight, and the joy of living. The name Lallan carries the meaning “God of mirth and joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Lallan usually hope their child will grow to embody god of mirth and joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May your life be filled with joy and mirth, just like Lord Lallan.
data.etymology: Lallan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of mirth and joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lallan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

It underscores the importance of indulging in the pleasures of life and finding joy and happiness in simple moments. This name carries a sense of celebration and encourages those who bear it to live life to the fullest with a playful and carefree spirit.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, Lallan represents the inner joy that comes from connecting with the divine within. It reminds us of the eternal joy and bliss that comes from realizing our true nature as the pure consciousness, separate from the material world and its desires. This name serves as a reminder to find joy and peace in the present moment, rather than seeking it from external sources. Essentially, Lallan signifies the joy of the soul, untouched by the transience of the material world.
